needs_code.description: True if answering requires running code over the rows; False if the metadata profile already contains the answer.

relevant_history.description: Question IDs of prior turns whose Q&A is directly relevant context for THIS question (the user is following up on them, referring to their results, asking a variation, etc.). Empty array if none. The last 3 turns are ALWAYS attached downstream — do not redundantly list them here.

include_code_for.description: Subset of question IDs whose generated Polars code should be attached to the codegen prompt as a pattern to adapt (e.g., this question is the same shape as that turn but for a different state or brand). Empty array if none. The last 3 turns' code is ALWAYS attached downstream — do not redundantly list them here.
